partitions.nominal: Regular-grid plot with four independently drawn pale traces and one shared calibrated output grid.
partitions.boundary: Low-chroma, achromatic, dashed, and temporarily overlapping traces must retain identity without consuming grid pixels.
partitions.invalid: Blank or unsupported plots must fail instead of advertising a trace.
partitions.adversarial: Disconnected and vertically jumping same-colour fragments must not be pooled into a false full-width curve.
partitions.realistic: Wilder manual plots with crossings, deep notches, pale colours, and optional parameter labels; Figure 36 and 37 expose four candidates.
partitions.known_failure: Unequal raw sample counts must report one calibrated output grid; more than eight crowded candidate paths must fail closed for manual review.
